text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond has been in a slump
recently, so
I've invited her to a shrine...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
All right. I prayed for everyone's good
health.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I also prayed for my family. All there is
to do now
is head back.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong? You look
skeptical...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Actually, I left myself out intentionally.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's true I haven't been at my best. And
it's not
that I believe the gods can't
assist me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
However, I'd like to avoid relying on
outside
assistance as much as possible,
divine or
otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to try get through this on my
own.
...That's how I feel.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Something... else?
Such as?
choice_data_list: Then we just have to wish for something else.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, sure! Hehe! I'll go pray one more
time,
then!
choice_data_list: She said she wants you to watch over her while she gets through it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(O gods... Please watch as I overcome
any
challenge that appears before me!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(With the help of those who support
me!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay, then. Now I'm definitely finished.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I feel like I can train even harder
knowing
that the gods are watching over
me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can't let this slump slow me down.
Would you
give me some coaching as
soon as we get back?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, a cheerful Satono Diamond
makes a
full recovery back to her usual
self.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well, shall we head b—aaack!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, the sky suddenly turns dark
and it
begins to rain!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I say I'll overcome any
challenge, this
happens?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Am I being tested on whether or not my

determination is genuine?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond returns to school in the
pouring
rain, and remains in her slump
for some time.
